g.text: Idempotency Keys: a lost response doesn't mean a repeated charge
Same key K, two attempts by the client -- only one charge ever happens
X LOST IN TRANSIT -- never reaches the client
retries with the SAME key K
return STORED result (200 OK) -- charge NOT repeated
The charge happens exactly once -- inside step 1, the very first time key K is seen.
Step 2's retry never touches the charge logic again -- it only reads back the result step 1 already stored.
The client's uncertainty was only ever about the RESPONSE. The operation itself was never in doubt.
